title: Bonnie Z NDE 32085
content: I was bleeding a lot, and then I became weak. After struggling to breath for several minutes, I collapsed near my bed on the floor. I was in a lot of self-inflicted pain when I blacked out, and suddenly there was no pain and I wasn't breathing or crying or gasping for air anymore. I noticed that I didn't even have the need to breathe. I felt sexless and ageless, and eternal. I felt overwhelming comfort and warmth all around me. I felt like I was floating, and my vision was a little weird because I could see all around me, and below and above me as well all at the same time. I saw the ceiling above me and it seemed to be glowing and expanding and opening up somehow to infinite space. And I saw my body below me, and all my blood. There was about two pints of it covering my arm and my floor. But I wasn't afraid of what I saw. I felt no negative emotions. I knew it was me but I didn't care - the peace I felt was so much better than the turmoil I would return to if I went back to my body. I floated continuously up, but just before I entered the light I felt like I should be in my body and so I started falling slowly and trying to breathe again. I started breathing and the pain came back. It was a struggle at first to breathe - I couldn't find my lungs. But when I did, I felt my body - and my pain- again and I was back. I tried to move my feet and soon I could move again and I was aware of my body. I don't remember communicating with anyone, only a feeling that there was a collective consciousness of souls who all had great love for me. I felt their love emanating towards me and pulling me higher.

out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Overwhelming comfort and warmth; felt sexless, ageless, eternal; no need to breathe; could see all around simultaneously.

arrival.other_being_detail: A 'collective consciousness of souls' with great love, whose love emanated toward her and pulled her higher.

environment.environment_other_detail: Ceiling 'glowing and expanding and opening up somehow to infinite space.'

boundary_and_return.return_reason_other_detail: Felt she 'should be in my body' just before entering the light.

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE with ascent toward a bright light; no tunnel; returned just before entering the light.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Reported sexless/ageless/eternal sense; ceiling glowing/expanding/opening to infinite space; 'collective consciousness of souls' pulling her higher; difficulty re-entering body described as 'couldn't find my lungs.'
